summary: outdoornebraska.gov blocks plain HTTP (Cloudflare), so the NGPC page stayed unread; an NGPC fishing-guide line seen only as a search snippet says 'Primitive camping' at the 250-acre WMA. Stored pin is on the WMA access road, not on a campground; a fenced, treed ~100 m plot with a gravel drive at ~42.5950,-100.5421 by the US-83 entrance may be the camp area. No group changed.
flags: AGENCY PAGE UNREAD: outdoornebraska.gov answered Cloudflare 'Sorry, you have been blocked' to a plain request, so I could not read the WMA page or a Public Access Atlas text that designates camping here. The only agency wording I saw is a search-engine snippet of NGPC's fishing guide: 'Ballards Marsh WMA Cherry (15) Details: 250 acres.; Primitive camping.' - I could not open the guide page (flipbook 404). The trailer-loop, pump, outhouse and site-count details in the note rest on aggregators (campertunity says 'just three sites with vault toilet facilities and a hand pump'; the note says 'roughly a half-dozen'). Ownership `state` assumes designated camping; if NGPC only allows informal camping on the WMA it would be `wma` (memory feedback_wildlife_agency_camping) - needs the NGPC page read in a browser.

PIN (cannot place with confidence): stored 42.5985,-100.5514 (same as the aggregator points) sits on the gravel WMA road between the marsh and the sandhills - nothing camp-like there on NAIP. ~800 m east-southeast, just inside the US-83 access, a fenced square plot (~100 x 110 m) with a stand of trees and a gravel drive ending under them is the most campground-like thing in view (centre ~42.5950,-100.5421), but I cannot see pads, a loop, a pump or a toilet under the trees, so I am not proposing a move.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stays. Both the road pin and the fenced plot sit beside marsh/wet meadow; the open marsh pools near the plot are small (well under 5 acres) and the large marsh basin lies 150 m+ west across wet meadow.

NOTE: 'State park entry permit required' looks wrong for a WMA - the state:NE row's own quote limits the permit to 'any state park, state recreation area or state historical park'. 'May be closed during hunting season' has no source I could read. Left for a pass that can read outdoornebraska.gov.
